name: kiddex-apps
description: Self-contained workspace: Panda Bamboo storefront, Essential Labs admin, Kiddex Creator Hub

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shop,gateway,admin,creators -c cyan,yellow,magenta,green "npm run dev:shop" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:creators"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix packages/kiddex-ui && npm install --prefix kiddex-console && npm install --prefix kiddex-gateway && npm install --prefix panda-bamboo && npm install --prefix essential-labs-admin && npm install --prefix kiddex-creator-affiliate
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shop && npm run build:admin && npm run build:creators
